## Problem and change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue if one exists.

## Validation

List checks run, results, and any blocked checks. For UI changes include a synthetic practice-page screenshot or describe manual verification.

## Review

- [ ] Change is focused and documentation matches behavior.
- [ ] No secrets, local history, or private page content included.
- [ ] Permission, automation, and data-handling changes are explained.
- [ ] Relevant regression checks pass.
